keyPoints: Sankhyiki aankdon ko ikattha karke, sajakar arth nikalne ki kala hai — pehla kadam sahi aur poore aankde jama karna hai — adhoore aankde galat nishkarsh dete hain.
Asangathit aankdon ko milan-chihn (tally marks) se varg-antaralon me baanto — har varg ka antaral barabar rakho — jaise 0-10, 10-20, 20-30.
Dand-aalekh alag shreniyon ki tulna karta hai; aayta-chitra (histogram) lagatar varg-antaralon ka bina-gap dand-aalekh hai.
Varg-antaral ke madhya maan ko varg-chihn kehte hain — baarambarta bahubhuj (frequency polygon) inhi binduon ko jod kar banta hai.
Samaaveshi vargon (10-20, 20-30) ko apavarji banao taaki seemaen overlap na hon — 20 dono vargon me nahi aana chahiye.
Aalekh ka sheershak, akshon ke naam aur paimana spasht likho — bina inke aankda adhura aur bhramak hai — pariksha me inke bina ank kat-te hain.
Aam galti: aayta-chitra me dandon ke beech gap chhodna — lagatar vargon me dande judte hain, yehi uski pehchaan hai.
subject: Maths
title: Sankhyiki: Aankdon ka Prastutikaran
